useCase: Detecting generado por IA smooth regions, texture anomalías, and information-theoretic irregularities
mechanism: Computes Shannon entropía for overlapping image blocks and builds an entropía heatmap. generado por IA images often show unnaturally uniform entropía distribucións compared to the natural variation found in authentic photographs.
accuracy: Media - 70-80% como señal complementaria a otros métodos
name: Radar de Disrupción de Entropía de Shannon
algorithm: Entropia de Shannon + Mapa de bloques
parameters: Tamaño de bloque: 16x16, Overlap: 75%, Channels: grayscale + per-channel, Metrics: local entropía, entropía varianza, min/max ratio
description: Mide information entropía a través de image blocks para detectar regions with abnormal randomness or uniformity, common in generado por IA content.

references.title: Shannon, C.E. (1948). A Mathematical Theory of Communication. Bell System Technical Journal.
Lyu, S. & Farid, H. (2006). Steganalysis Using Higher-Order Image Statistics. IEEE TIFS.

strengths:
• Information-theoretic foundation
• Reveals unnaturally smooth AI regions
• Funciona con cualquier formato de imagen
• Provides spatial entropía map for localization
limitations:
• Simple textures naturally have low entropía
• Heavy compression reduces entropía variation
• Studio/controlled photos may appear uniform
• Standalone precisión is moderate
